GN.Loading: Asking the companion for the board...
GN.NoWorlds: The Nemesis companion has no worlds yet. Run its import for this world first (npm run import in georgios-nemesis).
GN.GmOnlyBoard: Only the GM can open the nemesis board.
GN.OutsideHint: People who answer to no faction. Plot-locked people move only when the GM moves them.
GN.PlotLockedHint: Claude never generates or moves this person; the GM does.
GN.NoCourt: No ruler or archmage on record.
GN.NoChain: No officers on record yet. The nemesis generator adds them.
GN.NotRunning: The Nemesis companion is not running.
GN.BadUrl: The Nemesis companion address must start with http:// or https://.
GN.CompanionUrlHint: Where the Nemesis companion listens on the GM computer. Default http://127.0.0.1:47120.
GN.LauncherUrlHint: Where Georgios launcher listens; it starts the companion when you press Start. Default http://127.0.0.1:47100.

Launcher.NotRunning: The Nemesis companion is not running. Start it now?
Launcher.NoLauncher: Georgios launcher is not answering, so the Nemesis companion cannot be started from here. Start it by hand: npm run serve in the georgios-nemesis folder.
Launcher.NotConfigured: Georgios launcher does not know the Nemesis companion yet: add a "nemesis" service to georgios-launcher/config.json.
Launcher.Slow: The Nemesis companion has not answered yet. Check georgios-launcher/logs/nemesis.log.

GN.NoteHint: e.g. guards the harbour of Narkoc, hates the Institute, fights with a net
GN.Writing: Claude is writing a {rank} of the {faction}. This takes a minute or two.
GN.Made: {name} is ready. The portrait is painting in the background.
GN.GenerateFailed: Nemesis could not make the person
GN.Painted: {name}'s portrait is ready: pick the repaint or the layout on the board.
GN.PaintHint: Paint a portrait with artgen (repaint and layout, about two to four minutes)

Cast.SettingHint: When you open a place Georgios' Map Maker built, Nemesis gives its townsfolk names, species, tokens and stat blocks from the town's culture, and writes the keeper of the place (with a portrait). Off: Map Maker's placeholders stay.
Cast.FirstFolk: Nemesis: writing this culture's folk book (once, about a minute)...
Cast.Ready: Nemesis: {name} is ready. Their portrait follows in a few minutes.
Cast.Down: Nemesis: the companion is not running, so Map Maker's townsfolk keep their placeholders. Start it from the Nemesis board.
Cast.Background: Background townsfolk: no record, the same each time you open this place.
Cast.WriteUpHint: Claude writes this person in full (notes, magic, voice), keeps them on record and paints a portrait.
